culprit_citations.quoted_text: Company (1)(9) | Investment | Initial Acquisition Date | Reference Rate and Spread | Interest Rate | Amortized Cost (2) (7) | Fair Value (6) | Percentage of Net Assets

rationale: FX02 flagged fair_value_currency values of U_USD as not USD. The raw SOI has a Fair Value column and USD dollar markers for the fair value amounts; even foreign-par instruments disclose the fair value in USD with the foreign amount parenthetical. U_USD is therefore a USD unit token/normalization variant, so the source supports the extracted currency and the rule fire is a false alarm.
